name: CeraVe Advance Repair Ointment
description:
A lightweight, multi-purpose ointment that helps to restore the skin barrier, locking in moisture for lasting hydration and instant relief on very dry, chapped and cracked skin. Our Advanced Repair Ointment is lightweight, non-greasy.

Developed with Dermatologists, its advanced formula combines 3 dermatologist-recommended occlusive ingredients, including pharmaceutical-grade Petrolatum, with Hyaluronic acid, and 3 Essential Ceramides, to protect and soothe dry, rough, chapped skin on the face, body & lips and seal in moisture to alleviate dryness. It creates a protective layer over the surface of the skin that can shield wounded or vulnerable skin from harsh external elements and bolster the skin's own barrier capabilities for up to eight hours. Our ointment is non-comedogenic and compatible with all skin types, including those with sensitive or eczema-prone skin.
